usage:
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/example/openai"
	"github.com/example/openai/option"
	"github.com/example/openai/packages/param"
)

func main() {
	client := openai.NewClient(
		option.WithAPIKey("My API Key"),
	)
	result, err := client.Admin.Organization.Usage.Images.List(
		context.TODO(),
		openai.AdminOrganizationUsageImageListParams{
			StartTime: 1,
			EndTime: param.NewOpt[int64](1),
			BucketWidth: param.NewOpt[openai.AdminOrganizationUsageImagesListBucketWidth](openai.AdminOrganizationUsageImagesListBucketWidth1m),
			Sources: []openai.AdminOrganizationUsageImagesListSourcesItem{openai.AdminOrganizationUsageImagesListSourcesItemImageGeneration},
			Sizes: []openai.AdminOrganizationUsageImagesListSizesItem{openai.AdminOrganizationUsageImagesListSizesItem256x256},
			ProjectIds: []string{"string"},
			UserIds: []string{"string"},
			APIKeyIds: []string{"string"},
			Models: []string{"string"},
			GroupBy: []openai.AdminOrganizationUsageImagesListGroupByItem{openai.AdminOrganizationUsageImagesListGroupByItemProjectID},
			Limit: param.NewOpt[int64](1),
			Page: param.NewOpt[string]("page"),
		},
	)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err.Error())
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}

fields.name: StartTime
fields.description: Start time (Unix seconds) of the query time range, inclusive.

fields.name: EndTime
fields.description: End time (Unix seconds) of the query time range, exclusive.

fields.name: BucketWidth
fields.description: Width of each time bucket in response. Currently `1m`, `1h` and `1d` are supported, default to `1d`.

fields.name: Sources
fields.description: Return only usages for these sources. Possible values are `image.generation`, `image.edit`, `image.variation` or any combination of them.

fields.name: Sizes
fields.description: Return only usages for these image sizes. Possible values are `256x256`, `512x512`, `1024x1024`, `1792x1792`, `1024x1792` or any combination of them.

fields.name: ProjectIds
fields.description: Return only usage for these projects.

fields.name: UserIds
fields.description: Return only usage for these users.

fields.name: APIKeyIds
fields.description: Return only usage for these API keys.

fields.name: Models
fields.description: Return only usage for these models.

fields.name: GroupBy
fields.description: Group the usage data by the specified fields. Support fields include `project_id`, `user_id`, `api_key_id`, `model`, `size`, `source` or any combination of them.

fields.name: Limit
fields.description:
Specifies the number of buckets to return.
- `bucket_width=1d`: default: 7, max: 31
- `bucket_width=1h`: default: 24, max: 168
- `bucket_width=1m`: default: 60, max: 1440

fields.name: Page
fields.description: A cursor for use in pagination. Corresponding to the `next_page` field from the previous response.
